body.statement:
Under \(p_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,1)\) and independent standard Gaussian rows,
\[
 \frac{\lambda_{\max}(Q_n^\top Q_n)}n
 \longrightarrow_{\mathbb P}(1+\sqrt\kappa)^2.
\]

source.locator: Theorem 1, specialized to an identity population covariance and Gaussian entries

attestation.note: Stable DOI supplied for the classical largest-sample-covariance-eigenvalue theorem; the displayed node is its Gaussian identity-covariance specialization.
